provenance_coverage_carrier_nodes.note: this is the BAR-GATING metric. Requires a reachable Neo4j with an entity->chunk/document provenance edge. H631 proved the offline cache carries none.

shadow_metric_FLOOR_name_identity_only.WARNING: NOT the peer-form shadow metric. With Neo4j unreachable there is no node->chunk provenance, so retrieved nodes map to documents ONLY by name identity (node name == context document title). This covers title-entity nodes only and collapses toward the carrier-join. Reported as a FLOOR / lower bound, never as the headline.
shadow_metric_FLOOR_name_identity_only.granularity: DOCUMENT-TITLE (2wiki supporting_facts are (title, sent_idx); our nodes map to document titles, not sentences. HippoRAG reports PASSAGE granularity - stated explicitly, not equated).
shadow_metric_FLOOR_name_identity_only.gold_passage_definition: unique supporting_fact document titles per probe

definition.carrier_join_pass: ALL gold carrier titles present as nodes inside dense@16 (strict family join)
definition.shadow_pass: ANY gold document-title in top-16 retrieved DOC titles (name-identity floor map)

peer_form_headline.reason: a peer-comparable recall@5/@10 headline is deliberately WITHHELD: the provenance-free floor is not peer-form (it credits only title nodes) and publishing it as recall@k would misrepresent the system against HippoRAG-class passage recall. The honest headline waits on the Neo4j provenance coverage half.
peer_form_headline.caveat_block: GRANULARITY: HippoRAG/2wiki peer numbers are passage-recall; ours is document-title recall via name identity - a coarser and, absent provenance, non-comparable proxy. Do not place side by side with published passage recall until Neo4j node->chunk coverage is measured.
